items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You know I played with Louis Armstrong for one week in 1946.

ctx.x: Pops Foster. I met all these guys. I even played with Bechet. You know who lives near me? What’s his name? Played bass with Louis Armstrong – Arvell Shaw. Arvell reminded me that we played together with – I’ve played so many gigs I forgot. You know I played with Louis Armstrong for one week in 1946.
